8.1 **The Contractor shall withhold ten percent (10%) of each progress payment as Retention.**

8.2 **The Contractor shall cease withholding Retention once the total Retention held equals five percent (5%) of the Subcontract Sum.** Based on the Subcontract Sum stated in Section 4.1, this limit is Twenty-One Thousand Dollars ($21,000.00).
